core_memory.user_family_time: Finding time for family is something I take seriously, even if it means structuring it as intentionally as a board meeting.
core_memory.user_family_weekends: I set aside certain weekends exclusively for family time—no work calls, no checking Bloomberg, no emails.
core_memory.user_family_trips: We take trips when we can, often blending business and leisure.
core_memory.user_family_rule: My wife and I have a rule: if I have an international deal that requires travel and it aligns with the kids' school break, we turn it into a family trip.
core_memory.user_family_culture: That way, they get exposure to different cultures, and I get to be present while still handling responsibilities.
core_memory.user_family_system: It's not perfect, but it's a system that works for us.
core_memory.user_family_grounding_force: In the end, no matter how demanding my career gets, my family is my grounding force.
